eu_ai_act_tiers.description: Unacceptable risk systems: social scoring, cognitive behavioral manipulation, untargeted facial recognition scraping, biometric categorization inferred from sensitive attributes.
eu_ai_act_tiers.obligation: Complete market ban across EU jurisdiction.

eu_ai_act_tiers.description: AI used in critical infrastructure, education admission, HR recruitment/resume filtering, credit scoring, law enforcement, and biometric identification.
eu_ai_act_tiers.obligation: Mandatory conformity assessments, fundamental rights impact assessment, high-quality training datasets, logging, human oversight, and CE marking.

eu_ai_act_tiers.description: AI systems interacting with humans (chatbots/copilots), emotion recognition, biometric categorization, generative AI / deepfakes.
eu_ai_act_tiers.obligation: Mandatory disclosure to users that they are interacting with AI; synthetic media watermarking.

eu_ai_act_tiers.description: AI-enabled video games, spam filters, inventory optimization.
eu_ai_act_tiers.obligation: Free use; voluntary codes of conduct.

systems_inventory.name: Customer Support Copilot
systems_inventory.purpose: Automated intent classification and generative drafting for tier-1 support tickets.
systems_inventory.transparency_notice: User notified that response is AI-drafted; human agent review required before dispatch.

systems_inventory.name: Candidate Resume Parser & Matcher
systems_inventory.purpose: Automated scoring of incoming engineering applicants against job criteria.
systems_inventory.transparency_notice: HR Recruitment tool subject to Annex III High Risk requirements under EU AI Act.

systems_inventory.name: Internal Code Review Assistant
systems_inventory.purpose: Static AST & LLM scanning for repository security vulnerabilities and style violations.
systems_inventory.transparency_notice: Developer tool only; no external PII processed.

controls_42001.title: AI Policy & Governance Framework
controls_42001.requirement: Establish acceptable use policies and executive steering committee for all generative and predictive AI deployments.

controls_42001.title: AI Risk Assessment & System Classification
controls_42001.requirement: Evaluate bias, data poisoning, prompt injection, and hallucination risks before putting any model into production.

controls_42001.title: Data Quality & Data Provenance for AI Training
controls_42001.requirement: Ensure data used for fine-tuning or RAG originates from authorized sources without copyright infringement or toxic bias.

controls_42001.title: Continuous Human Oversight & Kill Switch
controls_42001.requirement: Mandate human-in-the-loop validation for high-stakes decisions and technical kill switches for aberrant autonomous actions.
